evidence_summary: BananoMiner is active and displayed recent September 2026 payouts for Folding@Home work.
The official BANANO site currently directs users to BananoMiner to earn BANANO by contributing CPU/GPU power to medical research.
No customer acquisition or person-to-person selling is required.
Actual profitability is unknown until the exact owned machine is benchmarked and electricity cost is applied.
payload.recommended_test: Install only the official Folding@Home client on an explicitly approved personally owned machine, configure it for the provided public BANANO receiving address through BananoMiner, run a bounded benchmark/work unit, record performance and power data, then stop and evaluate before unattended operation.
alternatives: Gridcoin plus Curecoin Folding@Home double-reward experiment: potentially higher combined yield but more wallet/account/setup complexity.
XMRig plus Monero P2Pool: simpler pure-mining economics but requires a Monero receiving wallet and may yield less useful output.
Do nothing: continue read-only scouting without a revenue proof.
